text_block_list.text: (UOOOOH!!)

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... Incredible...
So this is the roar of the Champions Cup crowd...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: You can't really feel the atmosphere just from an online video. It really is a whole tier or two above anything before.
choice_data_list: Yeah, it's a high-prestige race after all.
Yeah, it's a top-tier race, after all.

text_block_list.text:
A race where dirt champions gather from literally all over the country.
The excitement is on a whole different level compared to before.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Alright then, let's do this! Our biggest rival today is—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Well now.
Tran-san, I'm counting on you today too."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Accu-san is here too.
Hey there, nice to meet ya~.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Accu-san is strong too, but
the one we really need to watch out for is...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah, let's go blow 'em away today too,
come on!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna beat you guys black and blue
and leave you seeing stars!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: There it is, Espo-n...
Currently holding 5 GⅠ wins and going for a 6th today, the rebellious Umamusume stands tall as an imposing obstacle.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Tran, you know what's up, right?
Who runs the dirt scene right now?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
It's me, dammit, me! I ain't letting Furioso
or Falco strut around acting all high and mighty!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Think you guys can beat me?!
No freakin' way, right?!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Oh, this looks like a fun delinquent movie.
Those usually end up being pretty big hits, too.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Espo-san, Espo-san.
Don't get so worked up now.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: If you're a good, quiet little girl, I'll give you plenty of headpats on the track~.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Shaddup! Don't look down on me!
Like hell I'm gonna go quietly!

"...She acts tough, but nobody is actually scared of her.
If anything, they dote on her.
However..."

Her ability was the real deal.
There was no doubt she was a cut above the rest in terms of track record.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Trai-chan...
Yeah, yeah, I got it.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
A face-off against Espon... And on the stage
of the Champions Cup, no less.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, my heart's pounding before I've even started running...
I wonder what'll happen to me once I actually run.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
That's right... It was this very thrill that made me
come to the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I want to know. If we compete, just what kind of run
I can achieve. And, what if—

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
If I can beat Espon and Accu-san too,
I wonder how that'll feel.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
All right, I'll show them! Today, without fail,
I'll be standing right in the center of the winner's circle!
